{{Quote|My son, Vader was right about one thing. You now control your own destiny.|Kento Marek to Starkiller|<ref name="TFUultimate" />}}
[[Galen Marek|Starkiller's]] '''Trial of the Spirit''' occurred in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] during his final visit to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Shortly after Starkiller [[Skirmish on Cloud City|rescued]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], he felt as though [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] had urged him to return to the fallen headquarters of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Hence, he traveled back to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] once more in order to discover why he felt drawn to the Temple.

Upon his return, however, Starkiller found the Jedi Temple guarded by many [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[Jumptrooper/Legends|and]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|several]] [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|variations]]. Despite being overwhelmingly outnumbered, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] single-handedly killed numerous Imperials as he infiltrated the ruins of the Temple. When he reached the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|chamber]] of the former [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], he witnessed a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-induced [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], engaged in combat with a [[Kento Marek|Jedi]] unknown to him. But just as Starkiller defeated the Jedi in defense of Vader, he realized that it was a vision of his dead father.

Out of a desire to learn more about the father he had all but forgotten during his [[Sith training|tutelage]] under Vader, Starkiller made his way to the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]] where he hoped to discover more information about Kento Marek. After he fought his way past various Imperial soldiers that blocked his way, he came across a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that contained a gatekeeper in the person of his father. Starkiller then experienced a new vision, in which he was confronted by his own [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darkness]]; a manifest form of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] he could become. After a lengthy and hard-fought [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], Starkiller ultimately passed his final [[Jedi Trials/Legends|trial]] when he [[Shiak|slew]] the [[Sith Warrior (Galen Marek)|Sith specter]]. But just as he regained consciousness, the Sith apparition warned Starkiller that there was no escape from the dark side of the Force.

==History==
===Return to the Jedi Temple===
{{Quote|I am guiding him towards his destiny.''"<br />"''And I'm saving him from yours.|Simulacrum of Darth Vader and Kento Marek, fighting over Starkiller's fate|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[File:JediTemple-TFU.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi Temple on Imperial Center (formerly known as Coruscant)]]

Like Starkiller's [[Starkiller's Trial of Skill|previous]] [[Starkiller's Trial of Insight|missions]] to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]] encountered an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial]] security force of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[Imperial Navy commando]]s, and [[Imperial Senate Sentinel]]s. Although the garrison had been reinforced with more [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] due to his prior visits, including attempting to kill Starkiller on the spot as soon as he arrived instead of simply attempting to detain him like before, the Imperials' efforts to execute the apprentice were ultimately ineffective; Starkiller made his way deep into the Temple while dispatching many troopers.<ref name="TFUvg" />

After Starkiller discovered an elevator platform, he utilized it and ascended to the top of the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]]. Upon entering the damaged room of what once served as the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|chamber]] of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], Starkiller witnessed a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] between a [[Force vision/Legends|simulacrum]] of his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Kento Marek]], a former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had long since been [[Death/Legends|dead]]. At the time, Starkiller was unaware of the nature of the fight and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] identity. As Marek stood triumphant and prepared to strike Vader down, Starkiller immediately moved to his master's defense.<ref name="TFUvg" />

===Father versus Son===
{{Quote|It's not too late. You can still turn away from the Dark Side.''"<br />"''The Dark Side is all I have.|Kento Marek and Starkiller|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[File:Kento_Marek.jpg|thumb|right|130px|Kento Marek appears to Starkiller as a simulacrum.]]

The simulacrum of Kento Marek attempted to avoid a fight with Darth Vader's [[Sith assassin/Legends|personal assassin]] and urged him to reconsider his allegiance to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]. Yet his efforts to reason with the young [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were to no avail; Starkiller had no interest in relinquishing the dark side for he felt that it was all he ever had in his life. At first, Marek fought effectively through the use of his skills in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], as well as [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]].<ref name="TFUvg" />

Ultimately, however, Marek failed to overcome the apprentice's [[Force power/Legends|raw power]] in the Force. Though Marek evasively moved from one corner to another throughout the chamber, he was eventually intercepted by Starkiller, who proceeded to telekinetically thrash the Jedi all over the room. As Marek attempted to regain his footing, Starkiller sprang forward and [[Shiak|stabbed]] him through the abdomen. Marek fell to his knees in defeat and his simulacrum vanished, but not before he apologized for the life that had befallen Starkiller, whom he referred to as his "son."<ref name="TFUvg" />

Starkiller was shocked at the revelation that the simulacrum of the unknown Jedi had actually been his dead father. But as he reached out to his father, the simulacrum vanished, leaving him alone within the ruins of the High Council Chamber. The rediscovery of Kento Marek had a strong effect on Starkiller,<ref name="TFUvg" /> who then chose to search the Temple in order to learn more about his father.<ref name="TFUultimate" />

===The Tower of First Knowledge===
{{Quote|I know, PROXY. I can already sense them. But this is the only place that I can find out more about&hellip;my father.|Starkiller to PROXY|<ref name="TFUultimate" />}}
[[File:JediTemple_GrandHall_-_TFU.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Starkiller encounters several shadow troopers in the Council Spire Atrium.]]

After the incident in the High Council Chamber, Starkiller returned to the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'',<ref name="TFUvg" /> only to use it as a transport to reach the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]]. The [[Holodroid/Legends|holodroid]] [[PROXY]] warned him that the tower possessed a large presence of Imperial soldiers, but Starkiller was too concerned with rediscovering his origins to be deterred at this point. Hence, he dropped from the ''Rogue Shadow'' and landed on the surface of a platform that connected to the tower.<ref name="TFUultimate" />

As several stormtroopers were thrown back in all directions due to the force of the impact, the apprentice ignited [[Rahm Kota/Legends|his lightsaber]] and steadily wiped out the remaining Imperials that challenged him. Even the [[EVO trooper]]s, [[Purge trooper]]s, [[Shadow EVO Trooper]]s, [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Stormtrooper Commanders]], and their [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow Troopers]] were incapable of subduing Starkiller. When the platform had been cleared, Starkiller proceeded into the tower while [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] used his intimate knowledge of the Temple's inner workings to act as the apprentice's guide through a [[Comm unit/Legends|comm channel]].<ref name="TFUultimate" />

Inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|atrium]] of the tower, Starkiller was attacked by a combination of Shadow Troopers and [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Jumptroopers]]. As he overcame the numerous soldiers stationed throughout the tower, including several [[Jedi training droid/Legends|Jedi training droids]] that remained dormant but active since the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|fall]] of the Jedi Temple, the apprentice used the Force to adjust a shattered bridge that stretched across the central chasm and led to the [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] Chamber.<ref name="TFUultimate" />

[[File:Holocron_Chamber_-_TFU.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Starkiller discovers a holocron that leads to the final phase of his trial.]]

When he accessed one of the holocrons inside the chamber, a gatekeeper appeared in the form of his father. Although Kento Marek asserted that Starkiller was ultimately the only one who controlled his own fate, he did concede that the dark side of the Force had grown strong within his son. Nevertheless, he assured Starkiller that redemption could still be obtained. After the simulacrum of Marek reminded the apprentice of his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|inherent potential]] and [[House of Marek|blood relation]] to a Jedi, he implored Starkiller to complete the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]. At that moment, Starkiller slipped into the state of another vision created by the Force.<ref name="TFUultimate" />

===Starkiller faces himself===
{{Quote|You can never escape me.|[[Sith Warrior (Galen Marek)|Starkiller's Dark Side]]|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[File:Galen_jeditemple.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Starkiller stands ready for battle.]]

Trapped within a labyrinth of his own mind, Starkiller was forced to navigate his way through the area. At the same time, he utilized his skills in telekinesis to overcome the obstacles of the trial. Once the tests of his Force abilities had been completed, Starkiller turned to find the final challenge behind him. Out of the shadows emerged the [[Sith Warrior (Galen Marek)|physical incarnation]] of the apprentice's inner darkness, clad in [[Sith stalker armor|sinister armor]] painfully grafted to its wearer's body. Unknown to Starkiller, the dark specter's appearance was attributed to a possible future where he succeeded Darth Vader as [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]' apprentice.<ref name="TFUultimate" />

As Starkiller and his dark self fought each other in a vicious and brutal fight, during which both relied on lightsaber combat skills and dark side techniques, Starkiller managed to hit the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]], which caused his helmet to fall off. Before Starkiller could press his attack, however, he froze in shock of his opponent's face; it was his own, except pale skinned and twisted in features as a result of deep immersion within the dark side of the Force.<ref name="TFUultimate" />

While Starkiller paused at the sight of his own visage, his loss of focus was swiftly capitalized on by the Dark Lord, who drove the apprentice down to a lower level within the labyrinth. Starkiller regained his footing after a moment, just as his "other self" began hurling large pieces of debris at him through the Force. Starkiller managed to survive the attacks by evading and redirecting the objects back at the Dark Lord. They soon resumed their duel, which only grew in ferocity due to the renewed vigor on both sides, until Starkiller forced his opponent to the brink of the platform. However, the Dark Lord stopped his fall when he grabbed hold of Starkiller's ankle, whom he pulled down in order to haul himself back onto the platform.<ref name="TFUultimate" />

[[File:SithStalkerCloseUp.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Dark Side of Starkiller]]

Having captured the high ground, the Dark Lord telekinetically took control of several massive columns and hurled them at Starkiller, who countered the attack by using them as stepping stones to climb back up. As he ascended to equal footing with the Dark Lord, Starkiller impaled him from behind with a lightsaber blade through the back. With his final challenge completed, the vision came to an end as the apprentice's "darker half" became consumed in a bright light of Force energy.<ref name="TFUultimate" />

However, as Starkiller regained consciousness inside the Holocron Chamber, the vision had not completely ended. Just as he regained his senses, Starkiller's attention turned to his left hand, which had taken on the clawed and emaciated appearance of the Dark Lord's arm. After a final warning about how Starkiller would never truly escape the darkness that resided within himself, the vision came to a complete end. Starkiller was shaken by the revelation of his "other self," and when Rahm Kota inquired about the apprentice's discovery, he neglected to reveal any of the details of what transpired in his vision.<ref name="TFUultimate" />

==Behind the scenes==
Starkiller's Trial of the Spirit was featured in the Wii/PS2/PSP version of [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game]]. The level consisted of Starkiller's infiltration of the Jedi Temple and the High Council Chamber, where Starkiller faces the hologram of his father.<ref name="TFUvg" /> In the Xbox 360/PS3/PC downloadable content and [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Ultimate Sith Edition|''Ultimate Sith Edition'']], the apprentice fights Imperial troopers within the Tower of First Knowledge before fighting the Sith Stalker version of himself in a Force vision.<ref name="TFUultimate" />
